purpose: Discover, model, visualize, monitor and safely administer heterogeneous replication, replica, shard and failover topologies without pretending different engines share identical replication semantics.
navigation_model: REPLICATION tree/list; selection drives center and Inspector.

states.default: Render selected asset/resource and enabled capability-driven commands.
states.loading: Keep shell visible; show Skeleton/Progress in work area; disable commands requiring loaded state.
states.empty: Show module-specific empty state with one primary create/select action; no decorative cards.
states.error: Show persistent Problems entry plus inline error summary and retry/recovery action.
states.permission: Show permission-denied state without implying provider unsupported; commands disabled with reason.
states.disconnected_or_stale: Preserve last safe result as visibly stale where permitted; live mutations disabled until refreshed.

keyboard: Tab/Shift+Tab move among regions; arrow keys operate tree/grid; Enter opens/activates; context-menu key/Shift+F10 opens actions; module adds no unregistered global shortcuts.
pointer: Single click selects; double click opens default surface only where registered; drag/drop only for documented semantic targets; resize through standard splitters.
persistence: Project asset uses optimistic revision; window/layout state is device-local; save is distinct from Git commit and provider deploy/execute.
multi_window: Surface may detach through WorkspaceHost if ToolRegistry capability permits; no module-specific popout implementation.
accessibility: All critical visualization information has tree/table/text alternative; visible focus; non-drag alternative; supports Low Vision, Motor Assistance, Reduced Motion and High Contrast.
functional_regression: Command invocation uses CommandRegistry and repeats permission checks.
Background work uses TaskService and remains visible after surface close.
No secrets are serialized in asset/layout/tool descriptors.
Unsupported and unknown capability states remain distinct.
